subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publishing, saved browser preferences, and app locale refresh surfaces?
rationale: The requested rename is technically coherent but changes shipped public locale identifiers and compatibility behavior, which automation should not choose without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, workflow locale matrices, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form input only as aliases that resolve to existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publish metadata and navigation internals.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, workflow locale matrices, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available owner because the choice spans CLI setup, docs, Control UI, and recent accepted wizard i18n work.
